en: Black‑and‑white view of an early‑20th‑century European city street with electric tram #42 in the foreground, pedestrians and a cyclist, and multi‑story historicist buildings with shops and signs. On the left corner is a large ornate building with the rooftop sign "Pickert" and below it a restaurant; on the right are densely packed storefronts with German writing, awnings, and hanging street‑lamp poles along the tram tracks.
